interpretation_limits: A positive dynamic-minus-QV point difference supports the fixed modulation-package net effect on explored100DEV, not pure semantic selection, a general necessity theorem, significance or stability.
If QV macro is at least dynamic macro, this fixed comparison cannot support a positive dynamic-module net benefit; the result does not authorize beta/LR/rank/step searches.
This post-result requested control is not a new independent seed or untouched validation set. Aggregate selection and single-seed/DEV exploration limitations must remain explicit.

The strongest comparable baseline remains required for the paper quality claim. Historical wide-QV is not that baseline; actual PAS five-window resource savings do not establish strongest-baseline F1 superiority.
The initial base-only output equivalence is not newly measured; only the complete initial state and reload are measured in this control.

Resource findings concern the measured complete implementation and five matching windows. Extra-response compute and sign-buffer costs are part of the treatment package, not an unreported engineering optimization.
